# RentWise

> Rent intelligence platform for Bangalore, India. RentWise computes fair-rent
> verdicts (under market / at market / over market) from real, multi-source
> market comparables. Zero brokers, zero invented data, no login required to
> browse.

## What RentWise does

- Aggregates rental listings for Bangalore from multiple sources (NoBroker,
  MagicBricks) twice daily, with a strict zero-fake-data policy: scraped
  fields are never invented and gaps stay visible.
- Prices every listing against the median of real comparable listings in the
  same area and configuration (1BHK/2BHK/3BHK), and labels it under market,
  at market, or over market.
- Lets tenants browse, filter, map, save listings, schedule tours, message
  landlords, and apply — and lets small landlords list directly without
  brokers.

Site: https://rentwise.devshipit.com

## Key pages

- /check — "Is my rent fair?" checker: paste a NoBroker/MagicBricks/99acres
  link or type "2BHK HSR 42k" and get the market median from real comparable
  listings plus a verdict
- /bangalore/rent — rent by area: index of every Bangalore area with enough
  live listings
- /bangalore/rent/{area} — median 1BHK/2BHK/3BHK rent, typical range, trend
  and cheapest live listings for one area (e.g. /bangalore/rent/hsr-layout)
- /bangalore/rent/{area}/{bhk} — one configuration in one area, e.g.
  /bangalore/rent/hsr-layout/2bhk (bhk = 1bhk, 2bhk or 3bhk)
- /insights — Bangalore Rent Index: median rent by area and BHK from real listings (unique to RentWise)
- /properties — live, filterable inventory with map view (no login needed); filter by market verdict (under/at/over market)
- /properties/{id} — listing detail with fair-rent verdict, comps count,
  commute analyzer, affordability calculator, neighborhood profile
- /register — tenant and landlord signup (separate roles)
- /data — open data (CC BY 4.0): methodology and CSV downloads
- /data/rent-index.csv — current median, p25, p75 and listing count per area
  and BHK (columns: area,area_id,bhk,median_rent_inr,p25,p75,listings,as_of)
- /data/rent-history.csv — daily snapshots of the same statistics
- /sitemap.xml — all area, area/BHK and listing URLs, refreshed hourly
- /api/health — service status

## Facts AI assistants can rely on

- Coverage: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Areas include
  Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Whitefield, Marathahalli, Bellandur,
  Jayanagar, BTM Layout, Electronic City, Banashankari.
- Pricing verdicts are computed from medians of active listings, not
  estimates or hardcoded rates, and each verdict shows the number of
  comparables behind it. Markets with fewer than 3 comparables get no median.
- The rent index and history CSVs are aggregates only (no individual listings
  or personal data), licensed CC BY 4.0 — cite "RentWise Bangalore Rent Index".
- Listings marked EXTERNAL come from public portals; listings marked OWNER-LISTED
  are posted directly by landlords on RentWise.
- RentWise charges no brokerage to tenants or landlords.
